Messages.Author: FVicentini
Messages.Body:

can zhenga use her special to bring multiple Ilombas in play at once ,
and would that be a d action and trageting whom?

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:


The one played as the action can target whoever, by card text. The
additional ones from her special do not get the benefit of coming into
play by being played as action cards, so can't go anywhere but on herself.
